_doc: Hyenas performance set, built in Blender as a 3D scene (Fendi, 13 Nov 2026: 'I wanted a blender 3D build replica of the image we create from Gemini'; 'the look is ideal but the placement of me into the shot looks like a 3D person and hyena into a 2D scene'). Units: metres. World: the camera's foot is (0,0,0), +Y is away from the camera, +X is screen right, +Z is up. Every value is MEASURED (from a file), SPEC (manufacturer figure), ESTIMATE (assumption, with what it rests on) or DECISION.
look_reference: project asset bd601f72 (the empty front-lit Gemini plate; its look is the target: black night, red flares and red smoke either side of a black G-Class, pale packed dirt)

texture_still._what: Gemini edit of bd601f72 with smoke, flares and red light removed (prompt version hyenas-set3d-texture-nosmoke-v1). Gemini redrew the scene (an older G-Class, flash-lit): used ONLY as the source of surfaces (car front, bushes, grass, branches, sand); the light, smoke and flares are Blender's
texture_still._focal: ESTIMATE: the cabin (body 1.76 m, SPEC W463) reads 427 px/m and the fenders 520 px/m, 1.4 m apart in depth
texture_still._height: ESTIMATE: the roof line sits on the horizon row and 172 px of hood top are visible

car._place: DECISION: behind him and to his left, 2.3 m further from the camera than he is, turned to face the camera

take_camera._doc: The phone that filmed the performance take, from the frame at verse 13.0 s (proxy 15.012 s), 1080x1920
take_camera._focal: ESTIMATE: an iPhone main camera in 4K video is about 28 mm equivalent
take_camera._pitch: MEASURED: 17 door-frame edges meet at (540, 4685) px, so the roll is 0 and tan(pitch) = focal / 3725
take_camera._solve: MEASURED rows (cap top 165, floor contact 1225) with his height 1.905 m (Fendi, 13 Nov: 6 ft 3) + 0.045 m of sole and cap
take_camera._dog: MEASURED on the same frame: the dog lies in front of him and to his left, 1.5 m from the camera

render._fps: DECISION: 24 fps is the rate of the swap's picture of him; the cut can be conformed later
render._scale: DECISION (Fendi, 13 Nov: 'I do not have to be front and center we can create depth and scale me down'): the set camera stands exactly where the phone stood (same height, pitch and distance to him, so his perspective is true) with a lens 0.752 as long; he is 0.752 of his size in the take
render._shift: DECISION: lens shift (a crop of the wider picture, perspective unchanged): he sits right of centre, the horizon lower, the trees and smoke above him
render._move: DECISION: one slow move (build skill section 3: locked or one slow move)

wind._doc: strength over the shot: base + sum a*sin(2*pi*t/period + phase); shared by the trees and the smoke

_flares: DECISION: either side of the car as in bd601f72. Flicker: a burning flare's output wanders about 25 % at 8-20 Hz (ESTIMATE); here a fixed-seed sum of sines per flare, so a rerun renders the same light

song._doc: MEASURED in the handoff: verse time 0 is 45.849 s in the master WAV; the 4 s shown are verse 11.1 to 15.1 (dog lying, the first swap test)
